simple.meaning: שׂוּג (sûwg) is a Hebrew action word meaning “to hedge in.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 1 time in Isaiah, beginning at Isaiah 17:11. Its meaning becomes clearer as the uses are compared.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to שׂוּג (H7735) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: שׂוּג (sûwg) / H7735 is traced through Isaiah 17:11 with source-language evidence and verse context.

firstOccurrence.englishText: In the day of your planting, you hedge it in. In the morning, you make your seed blossom, but the harvest flees away in the day of grief and of desperate sorrow.
